facts.fact: Congo Quotidien reports that the Digital Transformation Project Management Unit (UG PTN) opened an international tender to connect administrative buildings of seven governorates and 44 territories in a pilot phase, via low-orbit satellite links and a GovNet VPN to Kinshasa.
The tender is run by the UG PTN, which reports to the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications and the Ministry of Digital Economy.
The lot is financed by the World Bank (credit 7602-ZR) and co-financed by the Agence Française de Développement.

systems.platform: VPN hub-and-spoke with LEO satellite links

COD.note: Low-orbit satellite links serve only government buildings under a tender; no licence or retail sale is stated.
